heading: Tonight
text: Partly clear east, increasing clouds southwest to northeast. Showers through NY then mainly south of I-89 by morning. Lows through the 50s, a few upper 40s Northeast, near 60 in the broad valleys west and south.

heading: Tuesday
text: Showers pushing out of NY. Rain from US-Route 2 south, scattered north, diminishing in the afternoon. Highs in the low to mid 70s north and west, upper 60s and low 70s southeast. Winds light, mainly southeast less than 10 mph.

heading: Tuesday Night
text: A few evening showers, more likely southwest, tapering off. Mostly cloudy, some breaks far north, and some patchy fog. Lows in the 50s east, low 60s west of the Greens Winds light, becoming east to southeast 5 to 10 mph.
